scope: Read-only documentary audit of temporal tests; no empirical model, statistic, simulation or market/test data executed/read.

findings.finding: DM squared loss tests expected MSE differences by date, not directly the mean of RMSE across training seeds or practical threshold superiority.
Predeclare DM per seed, seed-averaged losses or an explicit prediction ensemble; do not concatenate seeds.
Neither horizon h1 nor overlap n7 mechanically determines the HAC bandwidth; six shared returns do not bound all loss dependence.
Use actual horizon for HLN and disclose that the classical small-sample adjustment does not universally calibrate wider HAC, drift or estimated procedures.
Check loss-process assumptions, parameter-estimation/update design and nested pairs before relying on the standard reference distribution.
BDS iid null and nonlinearity limitations are correctly distinguished; record embedding/radius/sample/calibration and preprocessing.
Ljung-Box cannot subtract NN weights as ARMA orders; record model_df, positive df and asymptotic calibration.
Declare performance and diagnostic hypothesis families and marginal/simultaneous intervals; multiplicity cannot repair invalid p-values.
Seed-based power/MDE0 is conditional on dates and does not establish temporal power or exceeding practical margin.
Paired time resampling recomputes the requested RMSE functional; CI for mean squared-loss difference is not a CI for RMSE difference.
